integrity: All claims have mathematical proof with two reproducible programs. Internal self-review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to smooth coefficient-marked standard Ciani plane quartics over the algebraic closure of characteristic seven; coefficient triples are not quotient by projective isomorphisms. Geometric completeness of the finite-field census uses Ohashi Theorem 1.1. Superspecial is the rank-zero condition only for this split elliptic-isogeny family. A hidden equivalent prior calculation remains a priority risk.
title: Six smooth Hasse components and twenty-three transverse superspecial parameters for characteristic-seven Ciani quartics
